title: Embeddings rerank: dim mismatch + latency breadcrumbs (debugpad)
body:
Notes-to-self: trying to capture the breadcrumbs from the embeddings->rerank incident I saw on 2026-04-14/15. Goal is a compact reproduction, what I tried, command snippets, raw error snippets, hypotheses and next immediate steps. Quick TL;DR: intermittent 50-300ms p95 latency spike on /v1/rerank endpoint correlated with a small subset of requests where stored embedding dimension = 1536 but current embedder produced 1024 (and sometimes vice versa). Reranker threw DimensionMismatchError and then recovered, and at other times hung waiting on a cache lookup, resulting in p95 spike.

Observed symptoms (timeline):
- 2026-04-14 14:02 PDT: Automated synthetic rerank load generates p95 jump from ~85ms -> 320ms for ~8 minutes. Endpoint errors rate small (~0.8%) but latency spikes affected customers.
- 2026-04-14 14:03 PDT: First DimensionMismatchError logged in reranker-svc (trace_id: trc_9f4d2c). Error message: "DimensionMismatchError: expected dim=1536 for doc_id=doc:98765 but got dim=1024 from embedder v2.1.4"
- 2026-04-14 14:04 PDT: Downstream indexer showed occasional upserts of embeddings with length 1024 at same time as older vectors are 1536 (index table vector_dim column shows mixed values).
- 2026-04-14 14:10 PDT: After canary rollback of embedder to v2.1.2, errors drop but latency still elevated for a few minutes (cold-cache effect, reindex/backfill activity ongoing).

What I reproduced locally (minimal):
1) Run small script to call hosted embeddings endpoint (model text-embed-retro-1536 vs text-embed-lite-1024) and record lengths. Commands used below.

Curl (simple):
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-retro-1536","input":["two short sentences","query text"]}'

Python quick check (requests):
import requests
r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={"model":"text-embed-retro-1536","input":["x"]})
vec = r.json()["data"][0]["embedding"]
len(vec)  # -> 1536

2) Repeat with model text-embed-lite-1024 -> len(vec)==1024. So embedder model name mismatch obvious cause.

DB / index checks I ran locally on staging clone:
- psql -c "select count(*), vector_dim from doc_vectors group by vector_dim;" \
  -> shows counts for vector_dim: 1536: 12,345 rows; 1024: 82 rows. 82 are recent inserts (timestamp within windows).
- SELECT doc_id, vector_dim, created_at FROM doc_vectors WHERE created_at > '2026-04-14T13:45:00Z' ORDER BY created_at desc LIMIT 50;
  -> small burst of 1024-dim inserts between 13:58-14:06 UTC.

Error snippets observed in reranker logs:
- "2026-04-14T14:03:22Z [reranker-svc] ERROR DimensionMismatchError: expected 1536 got 1024 for doc_id=doc:98765 trace=trc_9f4d2c request=req_71fa"
- "2026-04-14T14:03:22Z [reranker-svc] WARN falling back to CPU-scalar-rerank for req_71fa"
- "2026-04-14T14:03:22Z [reranker-svc] TRACE cache_miss doc_idx=13 key=vec:doc:98765"

Hypotheses (ranked):
1) Canary embedder rollout error: new embedder variant was temporarily used by the ingestion pipeline (indexer) for some docs, producing 1024-dim vectors while reranker/queries expect 1536. This matches timestamps and model names in traces.
2) Model alias/config mismatch: ingestion pipeline reads model alias from config service; a recent config change introduced ambiguous alias mapping (embedder alias "default-embed" pointed to lite-1024 for some pods).
3) Retraining/quantization pipeline bug: a conversion step (post-quantize) truncated vectors incorrectly (less likely because vectors length is explicitly 1024 not partial zeros).
4) Storage schema bug: vector_dim column allowed null and a downstream migration tried to normalize dims and accidentally cast/truncated (low probability given psql counts).
5) Reranker coding issue: shouldn't crash on mismatched dims; should handle gracefully with a convert-or-skip path. The current behavior includes fallback to slower CPU scorer which explains latency spike.

What I tried (debug commands + outcomes):
- Replayed ingestion messages via kafka-replay tool for a single doc: kafka-replay --topic ingest.docs --msg-id msg_1234 --target staging-indexer \
  -> reproduced 1024-dim vector insert when indexer pod was running with embedder: text-embed-lite-1024.
- Checked config service at /v1/config/default-embed -> returned mapping to embedder image tag embedder:v2026-04-14-lite for 3 pods vs embedder:v2026-04-14-retro for rest.
- Grepped deploy logs: kubectl logs deploy/indexer -n prod | grep 'text-embed-lite' -> found ephemeral rollout at ~13:55 UTC due to CI artifact promotion race.
- Triggered local reranker with mix of 1024 and 1536 vectors and measured scoring path: verified code path where DimensionMismatch => raise DimensionMismatchError then catch -> fall back to CPU scoring (scales poorly). Added micro-benchmark: GPU scoring avg 6ms per doc, CPU fallback 38ms per doc -> p95 increases if > 1% fallback.

Quick fixes attempted (notes):
- Hot rollback of indexer embedder alias to stable tag (rolled back by infra) -> reduced error count to near-zero.
- Push a small server-side guard in reranker that rejects doc vectors with mismatched dims earlier and marks them for reindex instead of falling back; patch created in PR 2740 (linked). This reduces CPU fallback but adds reindex queue.

Longer-term fixes proposed:
- Make vector_dim a strict part of schema and add a nightly job that reindexes vectors with incorrect dims into a quarantine queue and triggers re-embedding.
- Improve canary rollout guard: require config-service to have unanimous mapping across pods before promoting alias.
- Add indexer-side validation: before upsert, assert len(vec)==expected_dim for alias; if not, write to quarantine topic and alert.
- Reranker: implement a permissive fast-convert path for common (1024->1536) cases (e.g., zero-pad or learned projector) so live traffic doesn't hit CPU fallback.

Open questions / things to check next:
- Which customers were affected (I have partial request_ids but need customer mapping from billing service). I left comment on INF-2213 to attach customer list.
- Did any offline reindex job run around the same time that could have mixed dims? Check cronjobs at 2026-04-14 13:45-14:15 UTC.
- Confirm whether embedder binary tags were built from same commit; compare git SHAs for embedder:v2026-04-14-lite vs retro.

Actionable todo (short):
- [ ] Add quick validation in indexer to quarantine mismatched-dim vectors (Jonas to own; I wrote a patch sketch).
- [ ] Add alert rule: rate(DimensionMismatchError) > 0.1% -> page oncall (SRE rule). (Lena)
- [ ] Run backfill job to re-embed quarantine queue and re-upsert with correct dims. (Aisha + Jonas)
- [ ] Merge reranker guard PR 2740 after tests; deploy to staging then prod-canary.
- [ ] Add end-to-end synthetic test: ingestion -> index -> rerank with mixed model alias to ensure fallback path metrics.

Random notes / heuristics observed (for memory):
- Even small % of fallback to CPU scoring yields outsized p95 impact under moderate qps because CPU scoring is ~6x slower and blocks some worker threads in Java scorer.
- We should log vector_dim at index time and include it in tracing spans to make postmortems easier.

Attachments I saved while debugging:
- trace trc_9f4d2c full logs: /tmp/trc_9f4d2c.log
- psql snapshot counts: /tmp/vec_dim_counts_2026-04-14.csv
- local reproduction script: scripts/repro_embed_dim_mismatch.py

If I don't get back to this by tomorrow: leave injector flag to block config-promote for embedder alias until we add unanimous-check.

End of scratchpad.
